newsitem.title: USA: Kohl's May same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: Kohl's May same-store sales up.

text.p: Kohl's Corp said same-store sales for the four weeks ended May 31 were up five percent.
Total sales for the month were up 27.2 percent over the four week period ended June 1, 1996.
For the 17 weeks ended May 31, total sales increased 27.9 percent, while comparable store sales increased 8.4 percent.

"We're very pleased with our 5.0 percent comparable store sales increase in May. This was on top of a 9.4 percent comparable store increase last year and in spite of unusually cool weather in most of our markets," said William Kellogg, chairman of Kohl's.

"The Memorial Day holiday helped boost sales in the last week of May and warmer temperatures are bringing the customers into the store for summer apparel. In addition, we continue to be pleased with the performance of the new stores opened in the Mid-Atlantic region," Kellogg said.
As of May 31, the company said it operated 170 stores compared with 136 stores at the same time last year.

In August, Kohl's said it will open an additional store in the Philadelphia market and its second store in Louisville, Ky. In October, Kohl's will open four additional stores in the Philadelphia trade area, an additional store in the Washington, D.C., market and its second store in Omaha, Neb., and enter the Pittsburgh market with three stores.
At the end of the year, Kohl's will be operating 181 stores, the retailer said.
